description: Final audit of LedgerLite against spec v2.0.
auditor: INTERIM — round-1 verdicts, to be replaced by the final IBM Bob audit
limitations: LedgerLite is a deliberately small sample API (SQLite, PIN-based access control, an admin token instead of identity management, a static sanctions list); it is an audit target, not a production banking system.
